instruction: Okay now you are in a room with a mirror in front of you and a glass window to your left. Turn to your right you will have six white stools and a teapoy with two white poles in front of you. Go straight in between the teapoy and the stool, which is on the left side. Now you are in front of a room with a narrow opening. Enter the room and go near the sink. Now turn behind, and to your right you will have a room. Enter the room, now you are in the kitchen area with four black colored stools and table with white marble finishing. Go to the left edge of the table and turn to your left, you will have a cupboard with white marble finishing and oven adjacent to it on the right side. Go straight and stop near the table and that is the end point.
